'''''Journey of the Minds''''' was an 102-volume ancient [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophical]] [[Book/Legends|text]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Sizinnian]] began to produce a definitive analysis of the text.<ref name="HS" />
